itens.trecho: Um excelente filme. Tive bastante curiosidade para ver este filme, porque até onde me lembro foi o primeiro filme chinês que vi. Antes de o ver, li um pouco acerca dele, e fiquei bem impressionado ao ver como o filme singrou no Ocidente, e conseguiu enfurecer os censores comunistas chineses.

An excellent film. I was really curious to see this movie, because as far as I can remember it was the first Chinese movie I saw. Before I saw it, I read a little about it, and I was quite impressed to see how the film did well in the West, and managed to infuriate Chinese Communist censors. However, I fear that I was not fully prepared for what awaited me.
